name: festos
description: FestOS - The Modern Multi-Tenant Festival Operating System (Web, Android APK, Desktop)

scripts.cap:sync: npm run prepare-www && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run prepare-www && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.build:apk: npm run prepare-www && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.build:release-apk: npm run prepare-www && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease

author: FestOS Engineering
